name: real: Kerberos password spray with one hit
description: EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES kerberos_pwd_spray_4771. Nine accounts fail pre-auth or do not exist from 172.16.66.1 inside 20 ms; then 'normal' gets a TGT. Internal source, so the attacker is already on the network.

alerts.label: true_positive
alerts.note: The account that succeeded is the one to lock. Perimeter blocking an internal IP does nothing; host isolation is the containment, which is a Phase 4 connector.
